description: List latest persisted scores across all scenarios through the proto-first ListScores contract so catalog consumers such as swarm-manager can read fleet completeness without legacy JSON compatibility.

requirements.description: A bulk list operation must read the latest score snapshot per scenario from the scoring-domain SQLite store through ScoreService.ListScores. The request must support server-side sort, order, page_size/page_token pagination, min/max composite filters, rung/category filters, and an explicit recompute flag bounded to the returned page. Each row must include scenario identifier, composite score, classification, working rung, calculated_at, digest, and optional heuristic priority. The normal list path must be O(query) over persisted score_snapshots and must never compute the whole fleet on request. In-repo consumers such as swarm-manager must use the clean proto contract rather than the deleted legacy bulk JSON shape. Measures-health federation must expose fleet aggregates from the same persisted snapshot read model, not from on-demand fleet scoring.
requirements.title: Fleet Bulk Score View from Persisted Snapshots
